title: Reachable configuration
statement: A configuration $C$ of a finite nondeterministic Turing machine on a fixed input is reachable if some finite sequence of choice bits, when the machine is run from its initial configuration on that input, produces a configuration with the same core sum as $C$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $C$ on its fixed input
Existence of a finite list of Boolean choice bits
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the machine's core sum, so its precise mathematical meaning cannot be rendered here.
